description: Turn the weekly report of a site on or off and set up to 3 competitors. Turning on needs a watch package in force. Turning on needs a watch package in force and a free site in it (409 with `limit` and `plans` otherwise). The first report runs right away; later ones run a week after the last. A new competitor gets its base this week and its new pages from the next. Saves use the expected version.

competitors.description: Up to 3 competitor sites (any address; the report reads the origin's /sitemap.xml).

paused.description: `false` turns the weekly report on; `true` turns it off.

name: save_weekly_site_report
title: Save weekly site report
